issues.t: Starter relay can corrode and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning. You may notice a burning smell, smoke from the engine bay, or starting problems.
issues.why: The starter relay can corrode, overheat and short circuit, which raises the risk of a fire even when the car is parked. Recall 25V-636 covers Supras and many BMW models built on the same parts.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and leave the hood closed. Call 911 from a safe spot, even if you can't see flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for open recalls now. Until the repair is done, park outside and away from buildings. The dealer replaces the starter for free. Owners report waits for parts, so call ahead.

issues.t: Starter can overheat from internal wear (recall)
issues.sym: The engine may be slow to start, fail to restart, or show a starter fault message. In rare cases the starter overheats and smokes.
issues.why: Wear on an internal part of the starter can make it overheat and possibly catch fire. Recall 26V-056 covers 2021-2023 Supras. Owners have also reported starter failures and no-starts to NHTSA.
issues.next: If you smell burning or see smoke, turn the car off, get out and call for help. Check your VIN for open recalls; the dealer replaces the starter for free.

issues.t: Fuel tank weld can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A smell of gasoline, fuel dripping under the car, or a fuel gauge that doesn't match what you put in.
issues.why: The welds joining the two halves of the fuel tank may be too weak and can split, letting fuel leak, which is a fire risk. Recall 20V-700 replaces the tank.
issues.next: If you smell fuel or see a leak, don't drive or start the car; have it towed. Check your VIN for open recalls; the dealer replaces the tank for free.

issues.t: Transmission can lose drive from an oil leak into its computer (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive power while driving, possibly with a transmission warning.
issues.why: A weld seam on the transmission control unit cover may be faulty, letting transmission oil into the unit. That can lock up the gears and cut power. Recall 23V-821 covers a small number of 2023 Supras.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away. If the car loses drive, turn on the hazards and get off the road. The dealer replaces the transmission control unit for free.

issues.t: Steering tie rod can break (recall)
issues.sym: Steering that feels loose, wanders or clunks, especially after rough roads in hot weather.
issues.why: Under heat and rough road conditions, the steering tie rods can be damaged and may fracture, which would affect steering control. Recall 20V-355 replaces them.
issues.next: If the steering feels loose or odd, slow down and have the car towed rather than driven. Check your VIN for open recalls; the dealer replaces the tie rods for free.

issues.t: Brake assist can drop out during engine start (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal feels hard and the car takes more effort to stop right as the engine starts.
issues.why: Engine software can cause a temporary loss of brake power assist during engine start. The brakes still work but need more pedal force. Recall 21V-598 updates the software.
issues.next: Press the brake firmly when starting and pulling away until the update is done. Check your VIN for open recalls; the update is free.

issues.t: Driver seat belt mount may be poorly welded (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom. The weld holding the driver's seat belt guide loop may be weak.
issues.why: If the mount fails in a crash, the belt may not hold the driver properly. Under recall 19V-653, Toyota inspected cars and replaced any with a defective mount.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls, especially on a used car. The inspection is free.

issues.t: Passenger seat belt may not lock properly (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger seat belt may stop locking or retracting the way it should.
issues.why: The passenger seat belt retractor can switch off its locking feature before the belt has fully retracted, so it may not hold a passenger in a crash. Recall 21V-554 covers this.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls; the dealer inspects and replaces the retractor for free.

issues.t: One or both headlights can stop working (recall)
issues.sym: A headlight goes out, with or without a warning on the dash.
issues.why: The headlight control modules can fail. Recall 19V-850 replaces them.
issues.next: Avoid driving at night with a headlight out. Check your VIN for open recalls; the dealer replaces the control units for free.

issues.t: Headlight aim can be moved sideways (recall)
issues.sym: No obvious symptom. Headlights may glare at oncoming drivers or light the road poorly.
issues.why: The headlamps could be adjusted side to side, which federal rules don't allow. Recall 20V-516 corrects the adjustment plugs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls; the fix is free.

issues.t: Backup camera picture can stay hidden (recall)
issues.sym: When you shift into reverse, no camera picture appears on the screen.
issues.why: A display setting could be changed so the rear camera image stayed hidden. Recall 19V-684 updates the camera software.
issues.next: Use your mirrors and look behind you when reversing. Check your VIN for open recalls; the update is free.

issues.t: Load capacity label may show wrong numbers (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom. The label showing how much extra weight the car can carry may be wrong on cars with dealer-installed accessories.
issues.why: Gulf States Toyota recall 24V-548 covers cars with its accessories whose load labels show inaccurate weight values.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls; a correct label is mailed for free.

issues.t: Electric parking brake releases by itself (manual transmission)
issues.sym: On manual cars, the parking brake switches off on its own, usually when the car is in neutral with the engine running and you let the clutch out. The car can start to roll.
issues.why: Several owners of 2023 manual Supras have reported this to NHTSA, and owners of 2024 and 2025 cars report the same thing. A Toyota technician confirmed it on one car. There is no recall for it so far.
issues.next: When you park a manual Supra, leave it in gear and turn the engine off, and check that the parking brake light stays on. Report it to a Toyota dealer and to NHTSA if it happens to you.

issues.t: Engine using too much oil (3.0L)
issues.sym: Low oil warnings well before the next oil change, needing to add oil between services, and in some reports the car going into reduced-power mode.
issues.why: Owners of the updated 2021 3.0L engine have reported high oil use, some blaming the piston rings. In some cases Toyota replaced engines. Toyota has not published a single cause.
issues.next: Check the oil level often and top up with the correct oil. If you're adding oil regularly, have a dealer do an oil consumption test while the car is under warranty, and keep receipts.

issues.t: Lag or hesitation when accelerating, sometimes stalling
issues.sym: The car is slow to respond to the gas pedal after a cold start or from a stop, and in some reports it stalls or drops into neutral.
issues.why: Several 2021 owners reported this to NHTSA. No recall or published fix covers it, so the cause has to be diagnosed car by car.
issues.next: Leave extra room when pulling into traffic. Have a dealer check for stored codes and software updates, and note when it happens so they can reproduce it.

issues.t: Weak battery warning or no start after sitting
issues.sym: A message asking you to replace or charge the battery, slow cranking, or the car won't start after sitting for days or weeks.
issues.why: Toyota issued bulletins about low-voltage battery messages, no-start diagnosis, and battery drain in parked cars. Storage time, heat or cold, and power drawn by electronics while parked all wear down the battery.
issues.next: If you park for long periods, use a battery maintainer. If the message appears, have the battery and charging system tested with the correct tester before replacing parts.

issues.t: Loud buffeting with the windows down
issues.sym: A loud, throbbing helicopter-like noise in the cabin when one or both windows are open.
issues.why: Air flowing around the window shape sets up pressure pulses in the cabin. It is a design trait and the most-reported complaint on early cars.
issues.next: Open the window only partly, or open both a little. Aftermarket wind deflectors made for the Supra are a simple fix.

issues.t: Steering wheel shake at highway speed
issues.sym: The steering wheel shimmies or vibrates at highway speeds.
issues.why: Owners have reported this. Wheel balance or alignment is the most common cause.
issues.next: Have the wheels balanced and the alignment checked, and look for bent wheels. If it continues, ask the dealer to inspect it under warranty.

issues.t: White spots or bubbles in the paint
issues.sym: Small white spots or blisters in the clear coat.
issues.why: Some owners found spots or bubbles in the paint on new cars. In at least one case Toyota replaced the car.
issues.next: Inspect the paint closely, especially on a car you're thinking of buying. Report it to the dealer while the car is under warranty and take photos.

issues.t: Rear hatch won't open
issues.sym: The rear hatch won't open with the button or key fob, and sometimes not with the interior manual release either.
issues.why: Toyota issued a technician bulletin on this condition.
issues.next: Have a dealer diagnose it and ask about bulletin T-TT-0644-21.

issues.t: Water on the floor from a blocked A/C drain
issues.sym: Wet carpet or water in the footwell, usually after using the A/C.
issues.why: The drain tube that lets A/C condensation out can clog, so water backs up into the cabin. Toyota issued bulletins on blocked HVAC drain tubes.
issues.next: Have the drain tube cleared and dry the carpet to prevent mold.

issues.t: Bluetooth won't pair or reconnect
issues.sym: Your phone won't pair, or doesn't reconnect automatically when you start the car.
issues.why: Toyota issued a bulletin on Bluetooth pairing and connection problems, fixed with software.
issues.next: Delete and re-pair the phone and update its software. If it continues, ask a dealer about bulletin T-TT-0578-19.

issues.t: Seat noise when sliding forward or back
issues.sym: A grinding or squeaking noise from the seat as it moves.
issues.why: Toyota issued a service bulletin for noise from the seat track while adjusting.
issues.next: Have a dealer check it under warranty and ask about bulletin T-SB-0006-20.
